descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
BUILD & BREACH CQB is a mixed-reality close-quarters battle training platform that turns any real-world space into a customizable tactical environment.

Build scenarios directly inside the headset by placing walls, doors, furniture, obstacles, and NPCs around your physical space. Or use Build & Breach Builder, the companion desktop app, to create custom rooms on your computer and send them directly to the headset. Build for yourself or another person, save and modify scenarios, then review completed runs together with session replay and debrief tools.

You can also scan your real environment and use its actual walls, furniture, and objects as part of the scenario. Add virtual walls, doors, obstacles, and NPCs on top of the physical space to create the environment you want.

Customize NPC behaviors to create different situations and decisions from run to run, or generate randomized rooms when you want to train against a layout you have never seen before.

Spatial anchors keep scenarios aligned to the real world, so rooms stay in place even if the headset is removed or passed to another user.

Move through your actual space, work angles, clear doorways, identify threats, and make decisions under pressure. Weapons feature realistic handling, while every layout can be reset, modified, and run again for repeatable training without being tied to a fixed virtual map or dedicated facility.

Build it. Run it. Review it. Improve it.

BUILD & BREACH

TRAIN ANYWHERE, ANYTIME.
